items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: I was trying to be a Duke Ellington style band... Because Duke had some great musicians with him. You had to have the fine musicians to have a great man like Duke.

ctx.x: You don't know Banjo Buck's right name.

Banjo... No. Banjo Buck... Banjo, fancy, got on his derby. And he worked in several pictures. He worked in the pictures. And he was a comedian. He worked in several of those colored pictures. You know, they had some black pictures at that time. Do you remember? I don't remember. And they had... And so Buck was in them. And he was gotten to be a movie star. And playing Banjo Buck. And he was... He got away from the band business. Start the acting. And I've never heard from him since. For a while he was in many…
Well, did you arrange a lead? A play piano? Yes.
